name: Carousel
description: Carousels at positions of the template: news published with “as news” when publishing a page, own slides and items of external RSS/Atom feeds. Accessible: pause, keyboard, no automatic rotation with reduced motion.
author: Enterprise Wiki

permissions.label: Manage carousels
permissions.description: Create carousels, place them, edit slides and external feeds.

permissions.label: Publish news in carousels
permissions.description: Show a published page as news in a carousel (option when publishing).
